== V3.e ==

Introduce Bomreks Bargains. Allows trading of Wool and Cotton, Metal bars, Rock boulders, Gems and Wood for coins.

*Each merchant needs a "trade license" which you have to order from the liaison first. Its under the misc section in the trade screen.
*Each merchant accepts coppers (copper), shillings (silver) or sovereigns (gold).
*Trading uses the "diplomacy/ambassador" skill, the better your dwarf can talk and haggle, the higher the quality of the bought goods.
